text:
Sam: Quick flag 1 renewal for HelixAI hitting on 2026-05-02. Procurement uploaded a PO but it's issued to "Helix Labs Ltd" and our contract lists "HelixAI, Inc." They insist on original 10% discount. Can we accept the PO as-is or do an amendment? @Anya @Marta
Anya: Do we have legal sign-off that an entity swap is permitted under the SOW? If not, we need a short amendment. Customer prefers not to re-execute full agreement.
Marta: We can do an entity swap amendment. Need: (1) Customer confirmation of authorized signer for Helix Labs Ltd, (2) tax ID, (3) whether the PO should be attached as Exhibit.
Sam: Procurement wants the effective date to remain 2026-05-02 (renewal date). They also asked if the invoice can be routed to the billing alias billing@helix.com.
FinanceBot: FYI, finance requires the billing entity on the vendor record to match invoice remit-to. If amendment changes paying entity, must update vendor and vendor W-9/EU VAT docs. No backdating of invoices.
Anya: I'll draft amendment language that: (a) swaps entity names, (b) references PO number 99231, (c) preserves pricing/discounts and term, and (d) states effective upon execution.
Sam: Can we do DocuSign for the amendment? Customer prefers e-sign.
Marta: Yes. We'll send via DocuSign. But current envelope signer is CTO@helix.com and their CTO is not on the new entity's officer list. They can supply board resolution or officer letter to show signing authority.
Sam: I'll request officer attestation and updated contact info. Also asked legal if a PO-only solution is possible (i.e., treat PO as standalone contract).
Anya: Legal says no, the SOW governs. PO can be attached but the SOW/amendment must be executed by an authorized rep.
DocuSignBot: New envelope created 0xAA77 for amendment to helixamend@example 1 sent at 1758000600.
Marta: Draft uploaded at https://redwood.internal/drafts/helix-entity-swap-amend.pdf. Key bullets included. Sam, can you validate the PO PDF we received matches PO# 99231?
Sam: Confirmed PO# 99231, amount and line items match. I'll upload PO to the ticket and ask procurement to provide board resolution if signer differs.
FinanceBot: Reminder: attach EIN and VAT docs before invoicing. Also confirm currency (PO is GBP). Our billing system needs correct tax rate.
Anya: I'll add a short VAT clause and a request field in the signature email for the EIN.
Marta: Once we have signer confirmation, I'll send the DocuSign envelope and CC finance@redwood. If they return a corrected PO first, we will attach it as Exhibit A to the amendment.
Sam: Customer prefers quick turnaround. I've set renewal status to "at-risk -> pending docs" in the tracker.
Anya: Draft approved by legal, sending to Marta for final upload.
Marta: Sent DocuSign envelope to legal-contact@helix.com at 1758000720.
DocuSignBot: Envelope 0xAA77 viewed by legal-contact@helix.com at 1758000805.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll add a note to the renewal record to reconcile invoice date vs. effective date after sign. Keeping this high priority.
